methodology.expenses: SUM of every contracted-expense source line, grouped by SQ_PRESTADOR_CONTAS + SQ_DESPESA with all line items retained. Repeated identifiers do not imply duplicate items.
methodology.revenue: Every source receipt line retained; national BRASIL mirror files excluded.
methodology.paidExpenses: Every payment source line retained and attributed through SQ_PRESTADOR_CONTAS, then linked to its expense identifier. Unlinked payments remain visible.
methodology.unknown: Missing fields stay unknown. Contracted and paid amounts are independent measures.
